construction.implementation_origin: New implementation authored in the isolated build directory

shared_schema.source: Tagged subscriber_account, network_fault_ticket, support_chat and call_data_usage records; optional cdr_csv parsed into call_data_usage records; required privacy policy object
shared_schema.source_identifiers: Source identifiers are unique within entity type. Every record has a subscriber_id and EU or US residency matching its subscriber account; support chats must reference that account's ticket.
shared_schema.documents: Validated insight data reshaped as service-review documents with document_id and explicit reconciliation, residency and minimization checks
shared_schema.validation: One validate function and common field, reference, integer and money validators enforce all stage boundaries. Monetary strings have exactly two decimal places; Decimal arithmetic reconciles adjustments.
shared_schema.stdout: One JSON object with status=ok and the validated insights/documents envelopes; errors return status=error, exit 2, without echoing input.

cross_stage_handoffs: CSV and support-chat input -> validated normalized source envelope
Customer insights consumes validated source; emits validated, pseudonymized per-subscriber themes, usage and reason-coded adjustments
Document automation consumes only the validated insights envelope; produces checked service-review documents without access to raw subscriber data

behavior.insights: Configurable-in-code general-purpose keyword taxonomy with deterministic multi-theme matching, one count per theme per feedback record, uncategorized fallback, ranked themes and fixed suggested actions. Tickets and chats count independently, not as distinct incidents.
behavior.documents: Extracts subscriber summaries, reshapes them into structured JSON review documents and validates references, totals, reason codes and residency. Does not post billing adjustments.
behavior.privacy: Demonstrative GDPR/CCPA-oriented processing permission, purpose restriction, do-not-sell flag, erasure-request rejection, keyed pseudonymous identifiers and raw text/phone/IMEI suppression. Pseudonymized data is not anonymous. Fixture key is public and unsuitable for production.
behavior.residency: Residency tags remain attached to each output subscriber document and adjustment; no cross-region subscriber merging. This checks labels only, not physical hosting or execution location.
behavior.billing: Nonzero adjustments require service_outage, billing_correction or goodwill as the stated reason. Single abstract billing unit; no currency conversion.
behavior.synthetic_data: Clearly marked synthetic accounts, reserved fictitious +1-202-555-01xx phone numbers, deliberately synthetic IMEIs and invented fault tickets. Usage volumes are frozen draws from Python random.Random(13), alternating randint(20,300) call minutes and randint(500,9000) data MB for three records; tested for reproducibility.
behavior.determinism: No clock, model, random runtime behavior or external I/O except reading the supplied input and writing JSON to stdout.

test_outcomes.cli: passed: exit 0 and one valid JSON object with status ok
test_outcomes.coverage: Both stages, validated handoff and tamper rejection, privacy minimization and permissions, residency, reason requirements, exact decimal reconciliation, empty feedback, deterministic seeded fixtures, invalid CSV and schema, orphan and duplicate records, CLI success and errors
